name: batchwise-pro-api
description: BatchWise Pro REST API — JSON file storage, Express

scripts.stop: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$p=(Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 3001 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 1).OwningProcess; if ($p) { Stop-Process -Id $p -Force; Write-Host ('Stopped process ' + $p + ' on port 3001') } else { Write-Host 'No process listening on port 3001' }"
